I've answered Dana in our direct message: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 185 seats.

The number comes from #north-team, a channel Dana is in. On 20 Aug 2025 she first posted 180 seats, then corrected it a few minutes later to "185, not 180." I couldn't see the amendment document itself in the files, so I suggested she check the signed copy, which she sent to June Osei-Lark, before the QBR.

A seat count isn't a finance figure, and Dana works on the account, so no approval was needed.
